labels.symptom: In right-to-left Arabic text, list bullets split off the first letter, and multi-column frames and tables ignore the right-to-left direction.
labels.root_cause: Bullet insertion breaks shaping runs, and column and table layout don't take paragraph direction into account.

labels.symptom: The font picker lists only the bundled fonts, and fonts installed on the system are missing.
labels.root_cause: The app does not enumerate system fonts and only loads its bundled fonts.

labels.symptom: On macOS only the bundled fonts appear in the font menu and installed system fonts are missing.
labels.root_cause: The system font scan (scan_in_background) does not complete or its results never reach the UI in the release build.

labels.symptom: Apps cannot be driven through one shared gateway: some need tokens, do not report unsaved documents, and have no quit command.
labels.root_cause: The apps' control servers differ in auth, in the state they report and in the commands they offer.

labels.symptom: InDesign INDD files cannot be imported.
Opening a document that uses missing fonts shows no warning and offers no way to replace them.
Text can't be given a language, so non-English words hyphenate and shape wrongly.
labels.root_cause: There is no per-text language setting to pass to hyphenation and font shaping.

labels.symptom: Clicking the overflow marker on a text frame does not let overflowing text flow into a new text frame.
On macOS the app's native document files have no icon and can't be opened from Finder.
labels.root_cause: The bundle doesn't declare document types or exported UTIs.

labels.symptom: PDF export runs without a dialog to choose the PDF/X standard, ICC profiles, or color settings.
On recent macOS, right-click does nothing in the canvas.
Fonts installed in the user font folders are ignored and text falls back to the bundled default font.
labels.root_cause: Font discovery does not scan the per-user font folders (~/Library/Fonts, ~/.local/share/fonts, ~/.fonts).

labels.symptom: Inline anchored ovals inside table cells are not rendered on screen or in PDF export.
labels.root_cause: Anchored objects are not handled in table cell text.

labels.symptom: On the Linux AppImage, Ctrl+C/V/X and the copy, cut and paste context-menu actions do nothing in text fields.
Text frames cannot be linked properly, and deleting auto-created pages creates more pages instead.
On Windows with AMD graphics the app crashes during startup inside the OpenGL driver; forcing DX12 works.
labels.root_cause: wgpu picks the OpenGL backend, which crashes in AMD's atio6axx.dll.

labels.symptom: Edits to a paragraph style cannot be saved, and a style cannot be deleted.
Double-clicking with the text tool doesn't select text, and the paragraph marker can't be selected.
Tightly fitted imported text frames go overset and the text disappears.
labels.root_cause: Line fit requires the descender, not only the baseline, to fit in the frame, and cap height is approximated as ascent times 0.72.

labels.symptom: Imported text set with optical kerning comes out wider and frames go overset.
labels.root_cause: Optical kerning is treated the same as metrics kerning during shaping.

labels.symptom: The tab bar overlaps the menus above it in some workspaces.
Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V do not copy and paste objects, though Alt-drag duplication works.
The rounded-corner handle on a rectangle does not let you drag to round its corners.
Right-clicking on the main canvas opens no context menu.
Smart alignment guides show the center between two shapes horizontally but not vertically.
Double-clicking a word in a text field does not select it, though drag-selecting works.
labels.root_cause: Double-click word selection is not handled in the text field.

labels.symptom: Clicking a color field only shows fixed preset swatches and never opens an RGB/CMYK color picker.
On Windows the portable app doesn't start at all and shows no error message.
Some text frames from an imported document don't render at all, with no warning.
Clicking the overflow marker on a text frame does nothing, so text can't be threaded to another frame.
Tables cannot be created outside a text frame, cannot be selected or edited, and have no styles.
Text copied from other applications can't be pasted into the app's text fields; only copies made inside the app paste.
labels.root_cause: The app seems to use an internal clipboard instead of the system clipboard.

labels.symptom: Native INDD files cannot be opened.
On macOS, documents can't be opened with Open With or by dropping them on the app icon.
labels.root_cause: The macOS Info.plist has no CFBundleDocumentTypes entry declaring the file types the app can open.

labels.symptom: Text copied from other applications cannot be pasted.
labels.root_cause: Probably clipboard handling does not accept rich text or external clipboard formats.

labels.symptom: Imported PDFs become raster images instead of staying editable vectors.
labels.root_cause: The PDF import rasterises pages instead of converting them to native vector objects.

labels.symptom: Copy, cut and paste do not use the system clipboard, and double-click and caret behaviour in text editing is wrong.
labels.root_cause: Text editing uses an internal clipboard instead of the OS clipboard.

labels.symptom: There is no option to generate vector artwork with local AI.
The app has no System theme option, so it does not follow the macOS light/dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: Theme comes only from the saved manual setting; nothing reads the OS appearance.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking never opens a context menu.
A PDF can only be placed as a graphic, not opened as an editable document.
The MCP automation server can't be limited to one folder, so a connected agent can read and write anywhere the user can.
labels.root_cause: The mcp command has no read-root or write-root options.

labels.symptom: An integration branch merges many open PRs with their conflicts resolved.
Fonts activated by font services such as Adobe Fonts show as missing and get substituted, even though other apps can use them.
labels.root_cause: Font discovery only scans font folders and never asks the OS for fonts that services register at runtime.

labels.symptom: At a larger UI scale, dropdown menus run off the screen and cannot be scrolled, so the lower items cannot be reached.
labels.root_cause: Menus are not wrapped in a scroll area or limited to the screen height.

labels.symptom: On Windows 11 Enterprise the app flashes a busy cursor and then exits without opening a window or showing an error.
Changing character formatting at a caret inside existing text does nothing, so text typed afterwards keeps the old format.
labels.root_cause: The caret branch of format_chars ignores non-empty stories and does not update the typing format.

labels.symptom: Changing the colour of one letter changes the kerning between it and its neighbour.
labels.root_cause: Text is shaped separately for each style run, so a colour-only change splits the run and the kerning across the boundary is lost.

labels.symptom: On Windows 11, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V and right-click do nothing while a document is open.
Menus and tool panels can't be resized, and the UI behaves differently from app to app.
labels.root_cause: Each app has its own UI layout code, so customization options don't match.

labels.symptom: HTML export is very basic and places page elements in the wrong order relative to the body text.
Print color profiles can't be imported, and PDF export has too few professional print options.
Users want text styles that stack and combine, like CSS classes, instead of separate paragraph and character styles.
Chinese, Japanese and Korean text cannot be typed because the input method's composition does not work.
labels.root_cause: The text input never enables or handles IME composition events.

labels.symptom: The color picker has no hex input, and typed channel values snap back to 255.
Help menu items are disabled until a document is open.
There is no Tabs panel or shortcut for setting paragraph tab stops.
On macOS, fonts activated by third-party font managers do not appear in the font list.
labels.root_cause: Fonts are found by scanning font directories instead of asking CoreText for the registered fonts.

labels.symptom: Fonts that are edited and reinstalled on disk are not picked up until the app restarts or the font file is renamed.
labels.root_cause: The system font list is loaded once and never watched for changes.

labels.symptom: With the Simplified Chinese interface, many characters show as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: The Noto Sans CJK SC font isn't embedded in the release build, so the app falls back to Japanese fonts that lack simplified glyphs.

labels.symptom: On macOS the window's traffic-light controls are out of line with the title bar.
On Intel Macs the app crashes right after startup with a Metal shader compile error and a lost GPU device.
labels.root_cause: wgpu compiles internal indirect-validation compute shaders with -std=metal3.2, which older Intel Mac Metal drivers reject, so the device is lost.

labels.symptom: In the font dropdown, the search button does nothing and typing does not jump to a font.
labels.root_cause: The font picker combo box has no working search filter or type-ahead.

labels.symptom: Clicking the ruler origin corner does nothing, so the zero point can't be moved.
Fonts in imported IDML files are reported missing even though they are installed.
labels.root_cause: The leading '$ID/' prefix is not stripped from AppliedFont values before font lookup.

labels.symptom: Placed PDF/AI graphics reopen in the target app with a different crop and scale after IDML export.
labels.root_cause: The IDML exporter writes no PDFAttribute/PDFCrop for placed PDFs.

labels.symptom: A packaged IDML embeds every image and links to absolute build-machine paths, so the images don't relink on another machine.
labels.root_cause: The package step uses the default embedImages setting and writes absolute link URIs.

labels.symptom: Pasting always lands on page 1 instead of the selected page, and moving a newly added page fails, saying the page doesn't exist.
Objects and text frames cannot be copied and pasted.
Clicking a text frame's overflow port does not thread it to another text frame.
On Linux, Ctrl+X/C/V and right-click Cut/Copy/Paste menu entries do nothing.
Contributors duplicate work because there is no convention to announce what they are working on.
labels.root_cause: No CONTRIBUTING guidance on claiming issues or opening draft PRs.

labels.symptom: In justified paragraphs, text marked as No Break is spread out with letter spacing instead of wider word spaces.
labels.root_cause: The No Break override makes spaces fixed-width, so justification falls back to letter spacing.

labels.symptom: Stroke weight, type and colour cannot be edited for individual table cell strokes.
Dragging in the Layers panel to reorder layers or objects does not start.
labels.root_cause: The Layers panel UI does not start the drag, although the engine move commands work.

labels.symptom: On macOS a saved document cannot be reopened, and its file extension is not associated with the app.
The README links to a fonts standards document in a repository that does not exist.
labels.root_cause: README references the private or nonexistent craftrules repository.

labels.symptom: The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: No guided setup flow exists in the desktop UI.

labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Windows, AppImage and Flatpak packages don't put the CLI on PATH, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: Rounded corners and drop shadows that come from object styles are lost when an IDML file is imported.
labels.root_cause: The IDML importer does not resolve corner options and drop shadows from applied object styles.

labels.symptom: Gradient and directional feathers from imported IDML files are lost, so faded images come in with hard edges.
labels.root_cause: The IDML importer ignores GradientFeatherSetting and DirectionalFeatherSetting.

labels.symptom: Placing the same image several times embeds a separate copy for each placement, so saved files become huge.
labels.root_cause: Each placement creates its own asset with no deduplication by path, and unused assets are never pruned.

labels.symptom: Right-to-left text in an exported PDF looks right, but copying or searching it gives reversed text.
labels.root_cause: The PDF text layer is written in visual order with no logical-order ActualText or ToUnicode mapping.

labels.symptom: Picking a font with no text selected immediately reverts, so text typed next keeps the old font.
labels.root_cause: The font picked at a collapsed caret is not stored as the formatting for the next typed text.

labels.symptom: Typographic errors are not corrected automatically when text reflows.
Some editing commands leave an extra undo step that does nothing, so Undo has to be pressed twice.
labels.root_cause: Commands that run inside another command each record their own undo entry instead of being merged into one.

labels.symptom: Grouping objects that are already inside a group fails with an index-out-of-bounds internal error.
labels.root_cause: The group command indexes the first top-level item of the spread without checking whether that list is empty.

labels.symptom: The app inside the macOS release dmg fails strict codesign verification because of Finder information detritus.
labels.root_cause: Empty com.apple.FinderInfo extended attributes on bundle resources are not removed before signing.

labels.symptom: A GREP style with an invalid pattern, such as a lookbehind, is accepted with no error and never applies.
labels.root_cause: Regex::new errors are dropped with .ok(), and the regex crate does not support lookbehind.

labels.symptom: In a single-sided document, a page shows the second page of a two-page parent spread instead of the first.
labels.root_cause: parent_page_for chooses the parent page by left/right side and ignores the facing-pages setting.

labels.symptom: Text in placed SVG files ignores installed fonts such as Arial and can switch from a sans font to a serif one.
labels.root_cause: SVG font selection does not actually load installed system families and falls back to the bundled fonts.

labels.symptom: Right-to-left text isn't supported.
Exporting from the CLI to .html, .rtf or .txt writes a PNG page render instead and still exits successfully.
labels.root_cause: The CLI export only special-cases a few extensions and falls back to PNG for every other one.

labels.symptom: Tamil text shows as square boxes in a secondary text editor panel even though it renders correctly in the main view.
labels.root_cause: The editor panel's font lacks Tamil glyphs and has no font fallback for Indic scripts.

labels.symptom: A crash or full disk during save can truncate and destroy the existing document.
labels.root_cause: Saves write in place with std::fs::write instead of temp file, fsync and atomic rename.

labels.symptom: Selection and Direct Selection tool icons are swapped in the Tools panel.
labels.root_cause: The icon mapping passes hollow=true for the Selection tool.

labels.symptom: Tool cursors are generic system cursors instead of tool-specific ones.
labels.root_cause: Tools map to built-in egui cursor icons with no custom cursor images.

labels.symptom: There is no auto-save, version history or check-out locking on storage the user owns for collaborative editing.
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: Unwanted gaps appear between consecutive paragraphs that use the same style.
labels.root_cause: The IDML importer and composer ignore SameParaStyleSpacing.

labels.symptom: Saved image clipping paths are lost on import, so opaque image backgrounds cover nearby artwork.
labels.root_cause: The IDML importer discards ClippingPathGeometry.

labels.symptom: Custom text-wrap boundaries are lost on import, so text wraps around the wrong area.
labels.root_cause: The IDML importer drops TextWrapPreference PathGeometry.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Chinese and Japanese text cannot be typed through the input method, and text cannot be pasted from other apps.
labels.root_cause: IME input is not handled, and paste reads an internal clipboard instead of the system clipboard.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a layer opens no options dialog, not even to rename it.
Alt plus the scroll wheel doesn't zoom, and Ctrl plus scroll zooms instead of scrolling sideways.
labels.root_cause: The scroll-wheel modifier mapping doesn't follow the reference app's convention.

labels.symptom: Bullets from symbol fonts such as Wingdings are reported as overset text or missing glyphs.
labels.root_cause: Private-use symbol-font code points like U+F063 aren't mapped to the symbol font's glyphs.

labels.symptom: An existing swatch can't be edited by double-clicking or right-clicking it.
On Linux Wayland the help search field in the top bar does not accept text input.
At 115% fractional scaling an unneeded horizontal scrollbar appears in the top header.
labels.root_cause: Rounding in the header layout width at some fractional scale factors.

labels.symptom: There is no way to rotate the spread view without changing the document.
On Linux, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V do nothing even though Edit menu copy and paste work.
labels.root_cause: egui turns these key presses into Copy/Cut/Paste events, which the app's shortcut handling doesn't act on.

labels.symptom: In presentation or full-screen mode, Escape doesn't exit and the UI is hidden, so users get stuck.
labels.root_cause: No Escape binding to leave Presentation mode.

labels.symptom: Optical justification and justification alternates do nothing to the text.
labels.root_cause: Not implemented.

labels.symptom: When two copies of the app run at once, crash recovery loses or takes over the other copy's unsaved documents.
labels.root_cause: Recovery files are named by a per-process counter starting at 1 in a shared folder, with no single-instance or ownership check.

labels.symptom: Large documents with numbered lists that continue across stories are extremely slow to open, edit and export.
labels.root_cause: The list start computation re-sorts every story and walks all items linearly for each story on every repaint.

labels.symptom: Thai, Lao, Khmer and Myanmar text breaks lines in the middle of words, and justification separates marks from their letters.
labels.root_cause: Line breaking only happens at spaces, hyphens and CJK pairs, with no dictionary word segmentation for scripts written without spaces, and letter-spacing splits clusters.

labels.symptom: Clicking the red overflow plus sign on a text frame does not let you thread the text to another page.
On macOS, text copied from other apps cannot be pasted, and right-click context menus do not open.
The headless MCP execute tool calls unknown app.*, view.* or window.* command ids UI commands and tells the agent to start the desktop app, instead of reporting an unknown command.
labels.root_cause: The headless dispatcher sorts ids by prefix into UI commands without first checking that they are in the command registry.
bug_markers: is a UI command; it needs the desktop app

labels.symptom: On Windows the MSI installer has no wizard or confirmation, the Start menu icon is missing, and launching opens a console window that kills the app when closed.
labels.root_cause: The MSI has no UI sequence or icon resource, and the binary is built without the Windows GUI subsystem attribute.

labels.symptom: Cannot import QuarkXPress documents.
Markdown imports as raw text and linked .docx/.md files don't update automatically.
Clicking the search field inside a dropdown closes the dropdown instead of focusing the field.
labels.root_cause: A click inside the popup is treated as a click outside it, so the popup closes.

labels.symptom: Text is never hyphenated, even with hyphenation turned on and a language like Russian selected.
After the graphics device is lost, the canvas stays blank or frozen with no error while edits and saves keep going.
labels.root_cause: GPU device or context loss is not detected or recovered, and the user is not told about it.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland sessions, dragging files from the file manager into the window shows a 'no' cursor and nothing is dropped.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30's Wayland backend does not support drag-and-drop, so the app has to use the X11 backend under XWayland.

labels.symptom: After a packaged document is moved, nested linked images go missing or the wrong file is picked.
labels.root_cause: Link resolution fell back to matching the file name before trying relative paths under Links/, and did not record the resolved path.

labels.symptom: Imported tables show borders on cell edges that were explicitly cleared.
labels.root_cause: The table perimeter stroke always replaced cell-edge strokes, ignoring StrokePriority.

labels.symptom: Brazilian Portuguese isn't available as an interface language.
Outside-aligned strokes on closed shapes paint over the inside of the shape.
labels.root_cause: An even-odd fill operation filled in the middle of the hollow stroke outline.

labels.symptom: Text frame inset spacing given as a single value is ignored on import.
labels.root_cause: The importer handled only the attribute and list forms of InsetSpacing, not scalar property values.

labels.symptom: The last lines of text frames go missing because they are treated as overset.
labels.root_cause: Frame fitting checked the full descent instead of the last baseline against the bottom inset.

labels.symptom: The About window doesn't credit contributors or models.
Adds data merge from JSON, several sources, filters and record grids.
A malformed ASE swatch file can crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The end-offset calculation in the ASE reader could overflow.

labels.symptom: On macOS, pressing Cmd+A, Cmd+C, Cmd+V or Cmd+Z in a text field acts on the document instead of the field's text.
labels.root_cause: The native macOS menu bar takes the Edit shortcuts before the window sees them and sends them to document commands even when a text field has focus.

labels.symptom: In a small window, toolbars are cut off and some tools can't be reached.
labels.root_cause: Toolbars had no overflow handling such as wrapping or scrolling.

labels.symptom: The app crashes when a hyphenated paragraph starts with a no-break letter.
labels.root_cause: hyphenation_points reads glyphs[j-1] with j == 0 when the first glyph is marked No Break, which underflows the index.

labels.symptom: Text in placed SVG files uses the wrong font or shows missing-glyph boxes for scripts the bundled fonts don't cover.
labels.root_cause: The usvg font database held only bundled faces, with no fallback to the shared font database.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, Print crashes, unrelated URL parameters turn on startup flags, and downloads use the wrong MIME type.
labels.root_cause: Print reached native filesystem calls, query flags were matched by substring, and Blobs were given a hard-coded application/json MIME type.

labels.symptom: Automation typing fails after a caret is set, missing stories return success, and negative page indices export page 0.
labels.root_cause: MCP tools did not validate ids and page indices and required the Type tool for typing.

labels.symptom: In the browser, a file picked for Place or Open goes into whichever document is active when the read finishes, not the one it was chosen for.
labels.root_cause: Asynchronous browser file reads did not remember the import intent or the document they were started from.

labels.symptom: An automation drag command with a huge step count makes the app run out of memory.
labels.root_cause: The control channel's ui.drag did not cap the caller-supplied step count.

labels.symptom: Numeric values filled into a command dialog through automation are dropped when the dialog is confirmed.
labels.root_cause: Generic dialog confirmation forwarded only strings and booleans to the command.

labels.symptom: README explains how to install the app on Gentoo from a community overlay.
Warnings and errors are never recorded anywhere, so a user has no log to attach to a bug report.
labels.root_cause: The desktop app never installed a logger, so every log call was discarded.

labels.symptom: Imported IDML documents lose anchored text frames and footnote artwork.
labels.root_cause: Forward story references and embedded frames were not resolved during import.

labels.symptom: Adds data merge options to skip records with warnings, join sources, read Excel files and use a grid tool.
Imported documents report missing fonts or render boxes because composite fonts and style-inherited fonts are not resolved consistently.
labels.root_cause: Composite fonts were treated as ordinary families and font inventory, preflight and composition used separate lookup paths.

labels.symptom: Command-line export options given after the export are silently ignored, and the docs disagree with the code.
labels.root_cause: CLI processed options in order and silently ignored trailing options.

labels.symptom: PDF/A export fails with an image interpolation error when the document contains placed images.
labels.root_cause: Images were always written with interpolation on, which PDF/A forbids.

labels.symptom: Japanese Mojikumi spacing rules from imported IDML documents are not applied, and preflight reports them as unsupported.
labels.root_cause: Mojikumi resource references were never resolved, and the composer did not apply their spacing rules.

labels.symptom: The CLI benchmark command crashes on documents that fail to render or save, and a failed Windows resource build panics.
labels.root_cause: expect() and panic! were used in the CLI and build.rs.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window without a branded background or icon layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG packaging had no background image or Finder layout settings.

labels.symptom: No FreeBSD or Flatpak release builds are published and AppImages cannot update themselves.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow lacked FreeBSD and Flatpak jobs and AppImages had no embedded zsync update info.

labels.symptom: The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app first and lists macOS builds before Windows.
CI fails at the clippy step on Rust 1.98 because of the new chunks_exact_to_as_chunks lint.
labels.root_cause: Rust 1.98 adds clippy::chunks_exact_to_as_chunks, which flags chunks_exact loops with a constant chunk size.

labels.symptom: Sending a huge row or column count through automation exhausts memory or crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Count parameters from commands were used unchecked, without clamping or overflow checks.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, pressing AltGr or other named keys while editing text types the key's name, such as 'AltGraph'.
labels.root_cause: eframe's web backend turns keydown events for named keys not on its fixed list into text events.

labels.symptom: Docs and the About box still name the renamed vector-drawing sibling app by its old name.
labels.root_cause: Sibling app was renamed from DrawCraft to VectorCraft and references were not updated.

labels.symptom: A single failing command closes the whole app and every open document is lost.
labels.root_cause: Nothing caught panics around command execution.

labels.symptom: The second row of fields in the top control bar is cut off at the panel's lower edge.
labels.root_cause: ui.horizontal vertically centres a two-row Grid before its height is known, so the grid grows past the panel.

labels.symptom: Most font menus can't be searched, and hidden macOS system fonts starting with "." appear in the font lists.
labels.root_cause: Each font field had its own plain list instead of one shared searchable menu.

labels.symptom: Double-clicking a character style does nothing because there is no options dialog for it.
labels.root_cause: No Character Style Options dialog existed.

labels.symptom: There is no way to change ruler units, and the vertical ruler ignores its own unit setting.
labels.root_cause: The vertical ruler was drawn in the horizontal units and no units menu existed.

labels.symptom: Closing a document with unsaved changes (Ctrl/Cmd+W or tab ×) closes it without asking and loses the edits.
labels.root_cause: Close paths did not check the dirty state before closing and discarded recovery data.

labels.symptom: PDF export fails completely when a placed PNG, GIF or WebP is damaged, and the error doesn't name the file.
labels.root_cause: Damaged images of these formats reached the PDF writer instead of being skipped with a warning.

labels.symptom: Importing RTF or tagged text silently drops emoji and other characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane.
labels.root_cause: UTF-16 surrogate pair halves were each passed to char::from_u32 and dropped instead of being joined.

labels.symptom: Importing a spreadsheet with a far-away cell reference makes the app run out of memory and get killed.
labels.root_cause: The xlsx importer allocated the whole used range before applying its cell cap.

labels.symptom: A failed batch relink leaves some graphics replaced, and EPS links show as modified even when their source files have not changed.
labels.root_cause: Replacements were applied one at a time instead of as one edit, and EPS preview bytes were stored in place of the source.

labels.symptom: The automation control server accepts unauthenticated or unbounded requests from local clients.
labels.root_cause: The control channel had no capability token and placed no limits on connections, request sizes, timeouts or MCP framing.

labels.symptom: HTML and EPUB exports can produce malformed or unsafe markup from document text and metadata.
labels.root_cause: Export did not escape text, attributes, CSS and metadata according to their context.

labels.symptom: Temporary print files and recovery files could be exposed or redirected through symlinks, and release inputs were not pinned.
labels.root_cause: Temporary files were not private, recovery writes were not atomic, symlink paths were accepted, and CI tools and actions were not pinned.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted ZIP-based document can use too much memory or hang.
labels.root_cause: Archive and XML parsing had no limits on resource use.

labels.symptom: Package export can write to redirected destinations or clash on Unicode or Windows device filenames, and huge repeat counts cause runaway work.
labels.root_cause: Unchecked numeric conversions, uncapped work counts and unvalidated package output paths.

labels.symptom: Opening a corrupted document file crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Unchecked arithmetic on document data: a spread with no pages and a next_id near u64::MAX.

labels.symptom: Rendering or exporting a very large page at high resolution crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Render sizes clamped to u16::MAX overflowed inside vello_cpu's tile rounding.

labels.symptom: Documents cannot be exported as editable PowerPoint presentations.
Paragraph and character styles cannot be edited and saved or deleted from the UI.
labels.root_cause: No edit/delete commands or dialogs existed for styles.

labels.symptom: Memory is not released after documents are closed, and inserting text uses more memory than it should.
labels.root_cause: The composition cache outlives closed documents, glyph-cache entries keep layout buffers alive through strong references, and text insertion over-reserves capacity.

labels.symptom: Sending non-object parameters over automation or MCP, or having corrupt crash-recovery metadata, crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Indexing into serde_json values that were not objects panicked.

labels.symptom: The automation server accepts unknown argument keys and does not report backend panics as tool errors.
Version bump to 0.2.0.
Export PDF exports immediately with hardcoded defaults and no options dialog.
Clicking a colour chip in a swatch menu does nothing, and some swatch menus show no colours.
labels.root_cause: Menu rows read clicks only from the name button, and the chip was hover-only.

labels.symptom: There is no command-line way to validate PDF/X-4 conformance.
Italian was not available as an interface language.
Spanish text is never hyphenated.
labels.root_cause: Only US English hyphenation patterns were bundled, so words in any other language were skipped.

labels.symptom: PDF/A or PDF/X export fails or produces files that don't conform when the document has placed images.
labels.root_cause: Images were always written with interpolation on and RGB images were left untagged as DeviceRGB.

labels.symptom: There is no way to distribute selected table rows evenly.
PDF export aborts when a gradient mixes RGB, CMYK or gray stops.
labels.root_cause: The PDF writer could not handle gradients whose stops used different output colour spaces.

labels.symptom: Underline and strikethrough colours, positions and paint order come out wrong on screen and in exported PDFs.
labels.root_cause: Colour resets were dropped on import and export, decoration strokes were not centred on their offsets, and underlines and strikethroughs were painted in the wrong order relative to glyphs.

labels.symptom: Ukrainian is not offered as an interface language.
Pressing a command shortcut that opens the command palette also runs the palette's first entry, so the palette closes right away.
labels.root_cause: A key press that triggered a menu shortcut was not consumed, so other widgets handled the same key in that frame.

labels.symptom: With Smart Text Reflow on, deleted pages and frames come back.
labels.root_cause: Reflow runs after every command and adds pages whenever the story is overset.

labels.symptom: After a packaged document is moved, its image links still point to the old folder and show as missing.
labels.root_cause: Links were never re-resolved next to the opened document for embedded images or native opens.

labels.symptom: Releases are not versioned and drafted automatically.
Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: Imported documents draw background layers over all other content, and font families with a format suffix such as '(OTF)' are reported missing.
labels.root_cause: The interchange file lists layers back to front but the importer and exporter kept file order; font lookup did not strip the format suffix from family names.

labels.symptom: The new-document presets have no A6 sheet size.
Menu entries only highlight and respond to clicks over their text, not the whole row.
labels.root_cause: Menu popups lost their justified vertical layout, so each entry was only as wide as its label and shortcut.

labels.symptom: On FreeBSD and other non-Linux Unix systems, dragging and dropping files onto the window doesn't work.
labels.root_cause: The X11 drag-and-drop backend was gated to target_os linux only.

labels.symptom: On Windows a native title bar is drawn above the menu bar, wasting space.
labels.root_cause: The window uses native decorations instead of drawing caption controls in the menu bar.

labels.symptom: Running the command-line tool with --help prints usage to stderr and exits with code 1.
labels.root_cause: --help fell through to the catch-all arm that handles unknown arguments.

labels.symptom: The Advanced Control panel is spaced too widely and its second row is clipped.
labels.root_cause: The panel layout was loose, and the shared numeric field allocated extra grid space.

labels.symptom: Importing a Word document with tracked moves drops the moved text entirely.
labels.root_cause: The .docx reader skipped w:moveTo elements instead of descending into them like w:ins.

labels.symptom: Data merge with facing pages stacked records on one page and left the next page empty.
Agent instructions do not point to the shared real-file test corpora.
There is no way to attach a rule above or below a paragraph or paragraph style.
labels.root_cause: There was no Paragraph Rules dialog, and rule edits replaced the whole rule instead of updating only the changed fields.

labels.symptom: The keyboard shortcut recorder saves a combination as soon as a modifier is pressed, so it never captures the actual key; some workspace presets also open the default workspace instead of their own panels.
labels.root_cause: egui reports modifier keys such as ControlLeft as key presses and the recorder did not ignore them; the workspace presets also fell through to the default.

labels.symptom: Placing text that starts with a page break with autoflow adds dozens of empty pages.
labels.root_cause: Autoflow estimated needed frames from frames cut short by breaks.

labels.symptom: CI workflows print Node 20 deprecation warnings for outdated GitHub Actions.
labels.root_cause: Workflow files pin GitHub Actions versions that run on the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

labels.symptom: Users who install a release can't tell where the CLI is installed, so they can't register the MCP server.
labels.root_cause: The docs only covered registering the MCP server from a source build.

labels.symptom: FreeBSD CI tests time out or fail when they call git on the synced checkout.
labels.root_cause: The workflow had no git installed, did not mark the checkout as safe.directory, and gave the VM only 2 vCPUs.

labels.symptom: No RISC-V Linux packages (deb, rpm, tar.gz) are published for releases.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow has no riscv64 cross-compile and packaging job.

labels.symptom: No way to follow the system light/dark appearance or pick separate light and dark themes.
With Japanese chosen as the interface language, most dialogs, tooltips and status lines are still in English.
labels.root_cause: The Japanese column held English text, and many tr() keys had no row in any table.

labels.symptom: Multi-column text frames show no rule lines between the columns.
Setting an object's blend mode with lowercase names reports success but leaves the blend unchanged.
labels.root_cause: The blend parameter was deserialized against exact PascalCase enum names and failures were silently dropped instead of using BlendMode::parse.

labels.symptom: In multi-column text frames, text after a paragraph that spans columns restarts at the top of the next column and overlaps the span.
labels.root_cause: Column composition did not treat spanning paragraphs as band boundaries, so following text was not placed below the span.

labels.symptom: The app is not listed in the Omarchy app catalog.
labels.root_cause: There is no omastore.toml manifest.

labels.symptom: Japanese interface labels and text show missing glyphs when no Japanese system fonts are installed.
labels.root_cause: No Japanese fallback font was bundled with the app.

labels.symptom: There is no way to set selected text as warichu inside the line.
At larger UI scales, long menus and dialogs run off the screen and their buttons cannot be reached.
labels.root_cause: Menus and dialogs did not scroll within the available space.

labels.symptom: Lines containing a tab run past the column's right edge.
labels.root_cause: The line breaker counted tabs as zero width.

labels.symptom: In justified paragraphs, the line before a column, frame or page break is stretched to full width.
labels.root_cause: Composition treated break characters like a forced line break instead of using the last-line alignment.

labels.symptom: In justified paragraphs, lines containing a tab are not justified and end short.
labels.root_cause: Justification skipped lines containing tabs.

labels.symptom: After an imported page break, the next paragraph merges into the previous one and takes its style.
labels.root_cause: Break characters were kept inside the paragraph instead of ending it.

labels.symptom: On case-sensitive file systems, fonts bundled in a package's 'Document fonts' folder are not loaded and text uses substitutes.
labels.root_cause: The Document Fonts folder name was matched case-sensitively.

labels.symptom: Imported IDML tables ignore their table and cell styles and draw with a full black grid.
labels.root_cause: Table region and cell style inheritance was not resolved, and cell height counted descent and inset twice.

labels.symptom: Affinity documents cannot be opened.
A word wider than the column runs past the frame or overlaps glyphs, and exactly fitting lines get broken.
labels.root_cause: Line breaker had no emergency break points and no rounding tolerance for full-measure lines.

labels.symptom: Any change that adds a new English UI string fails the build because a translation catalog test requires an exact key match.
labels.root_cause: The catalog test required the translated catalog to match every English key exactly instead of allowing untranslated strings to fall back to English.

labels.symptom: Paragraphs set to Split Columns are laid out at full column width.
labels.root_cause: Split Columns was not implemented in composition.

labels.symptom: Duplicate-key tests fail because a translation key appears twice in the catalogs.
labels.root_cause: Two merged PRs each added the same 'Tint:' row.

labels.symptom: On Windows hybrid-graphics laptops the app crashes seconds after launch inside the Vulkan driver.
labels.root_cause: wgpu default backends pick Vulkan first on Windows, hitting buggy AMD Vulkan drivers; no DX12 preference or startup fallback.

labels.symptom: Imported numbered lists ignore their number format and expression, and empty list paragraphs get a number.
labels.root_cause: IDML numbering format/expression attributes were not imported or modelled.

labels.symptom: PDF export reports a missing linked image as could not be decoded, as if damaged.
labels.root_cause: Export did not distinguish images with no data from undecodable ones.
bug_markers: could not be decoded and was skipped

labels.symptom: Documents saved from the web version are corrupt and can't be reopened ("invalid Zip archive").
labels.root_cause: The serialize command passed binary zip bytes through from_utf8_lossy, corrupting them; it now returns base64.

labels.symptom: PDF export repeats image conversions and page object lookups, so it runs slowly.
labels.root_cause: Image conversions were not cached and page objects were searched linearly.

labels.symptom: Text variables such as dates and running headers disappear from imported documents.
labels.root_cause: IDML import dropped TextVariable definitions and instances.

labels.symptom: Extreme warichu settings produce invalid PDFs or a panic during layout.
labels.root_cause: Warichu line spacing wasn't clamped, and the break-minimum sum overflowed on 32-bit targets.

labels.symptom: The headless MCP server reports nonexistent or mistyped command ids as UI commands and tells the agent to start the desktop app.
labels.root_cause: Headless execute classified any id with an app., view. or window. prefix as a UI command without checking a registered command catalog.

labels.symptom: Imported text inside cross-references loses its local formatting, so the lines break differently.
labels.root_cause: The paragraph-level CrossReferenceSource nesting dropped the inner range's local attributes.

labels.symptom: After reopening a document, explicitly set text defaults turn into inherited values.
labels.root_cause: Loading did not tell an omitted field apart from an explicit null.

labels.symptom: Zero, negative or extreme zoom values make the rulers hang or draw broken ticks.
labels.root_cause: Ruler tick spacing loop assumes a positive finite zoom without validating it.

labels.symptom: Rotating the spread view by a non-quarter-turn or malformed angle silently applies an unexpected rotation.
labels.root_cause: Integer division converts degrees to quarter turns without validation, and unparseable values default to 90.

labels.symptom: Measurements just below a pica or cicero boundary display as 0p12 instead of 1p0.
labels.root_cause: The carry into the next major unit was checked before rounding the fraction to display precision.

labels.symptom: Smart guides do not show alignment or centring on the vertical axis between objects.
labels.root_cause: The baseline-grid snap ran before the smart-guide passes, and there was no snap for centring between two objects.

labels.symptom: Selecting or replacing text that contains multibyte characters can cause an internal error on the next edit or caret move.
labels.root_cause: Selection offsets were clamped to the text length but not snapped to UTF-8 character boundaries.

labels.symptom: Justified text with tight word spacing puts single letter-spaced words on lines, and fixed-width spaces stretch.
labels.root_cause: The line breaker measured overflow stretch in units of the line's own word-space stretch, and it handed leftover stretch to every kind of space.

labels.symptom: Most of the interface stays in English when German is selected.
labels.root_cause: The German catalog covered only a small part of the strings.

labels.symptom: Fonts installed while the app is running are still missing or fall back after a font rescan.
labels.root_cause: Cached glyph misses and attempted fallback families were not cleared on a system-font rescan, and an in-flight lookup could repopulate the cache.

labels.symptom: GREP styles using dialect classes are silently skipped, and Find/Change mishandles ~ codes.
labels.root_cause: Patterns were passed to the regex crate, which doesn't know the dialect's classes, and ~ codes used a plain string replace.

labels.symptom: A combining mark at the start of a text run is placed wrongly or shows as a missing-glyph box instead of attaching to its base letter.
labels.root_cause: Each run is shaped on its own, so a leading combining mark is cut off from its base character in the previous run.

labels.symptom: Some labels and buttons stay in English when the interface language is Chinese.
labels.root_cause: UI strings were hardcoded instead of going through the translation lookup.

labels.symptom: A small crafted DTD can exhaust memory, crash the app or freeze the editor.
labels.root_cause: Parameter-entity expansion, nesting and sequence matching had no size or depth limits.

labels.symptom: Placed files changed by another app are not updated automatically.
The New Document dialog is a bare grid of text boxes with no presets.
Help menu items are disabled when no document is open.
labels.root_cause: Help menu items were gated on there being an open document.

labels.symptom: Objects do not snap to grids, guides or other objects, and there are no smart guides.
In documents with mixed font sizes or Arabic text, lines shift, small text drops below the baseline and frames become overset.
labels.root_cause: The CJK leading model and character alignment were applied under every composer instead of only the Japanese composers.

labels.symptom: Automatic page numbers show Western digits or missing-glyph boxes in text set to use native digits.
labels.root_cause: Page number text skipped the digit mapping that typed text goes through.

labels.symptom: CJK-only typography menu items appear for every interface language.
Documents have no chapter numbering style or source, and section prefixes accept invalid characters.
The Numbering & Section Options command opens a generic form instead of a dedicated dialog.
There is no way to set tab stops on paragraphs.
List rows show no visible highlight under the pointer, and the floating scroll bar covers text or grid columns in panels.
labels.root_cause: The hover colour is too close to the background, and layouts do not leave room for egui's floating scroll bar.

labels.symptom: The ruler corner crosshair does nothing; the ruler zero point cannot be moved.
A very large section start number crashes the app or shows page number 0.
labels.root_cause: The start number uses an unchecked u32 cast, and page numbers are added without overflow checks.

labels.symptom: Double-click and triple-click on the canvas do nothing; text can only be selected by dragging.
labels.root_cause: egui's button_double_clicked/button_triple_clicked are only true on release but were checked in the press branch.

labels.symptom: On macOS, text copied from other apps cannot be pasted into the canvas text editor, and copied text does not reach other apps.
labels.root_cause: Native menu Copy/Cut/Paste ran internal commands directly, bypassing egui clipboard events.

labels.symptom: There is no Japanese composition, no frame grids and no full CJK interface.
The progress and parity docs are out of date.
Some interchange files open with pages' content missing and no warning, or crash on certain link paths.
labels.root_cause: Exact zip entry name lookup silently skipped parts; percent-decoding sliced by byte offsets inside UTF-8.

labels.symptom: A line that ends in a larger paragraph return is set too close to the line above.
labels.root_cause: Composition left the paragraph mark's size out of the line's auto leading.

labels.symptom: Clicking or dragging the ruler corner does nothing, so the zero point cannot be moved.
labels.root_cause: No zero point support in the document or canvas.

labels.symptom: Paragraph style options lack sections for several stored attributes.
Fonts installed on the system are not available; only the bundled fonts are listed and used.
labels.root_cause: System fonts were catalogued only when a character needed a fallback font, so lookups by family name missed installed fonts.

labels.symptom: Many paragraph border, shading, span and list settings are missing.
IDML fonts with a $ID/ prefix are reported missing, placed PDFs lose their page and crop, and packaged IDML embeds images.
labels.root_cause: The IDML importer kept the $ID/ prefix and the exporter wrote no PDFAttribute.

labels.symptom: Japanese typography settings such as ruby and emphasis marks are missing, and ruby in imported files is lost.
labels.root_cause: Model lacked CJK attributes; import read only true/false for RubyFlag.

labels.symptom: Style dialogs have no sections for CJK typography settings.
Many CJK settings and the Ruby dialog are missing from the style dialogs.
Chinese, Japanese and Korean input methods cannot type into canvas text.
labels.root_cause: Custom canvas text editor ignored IME events.

labels.symptom: Paste and Paste in Place always put the copy on the first page instead of the page in view.
labels.root_cause: edit.paste always targeted SpreadRef::Doc(0).

labels.symptom: Pasted objects always land on the first page instead of the page in view.
labels.root_cause: The paste command had spread 0 hard-coded.

labels.symptom: Scripts that select text by character count select too little after accented letters.
labels.root_cause: The command docs did not say that offsets are UTF-8 bytes.

labels.symptom: In justified text, No Break spaces and nonbreaking spaces stay fixed-width, so lines get letter-spaced.
labels.root_cause: Justification skipped no_break glyphs when collecting stretchable spaces and treated U+00A0 as a letter.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the canvas opens no context menu.
The interface has no Russian translation.
Layers and objects cannot be reordered by dragging in the Layers panel.
labels.root_cause: The Layers panel had no drag and drop.

labels.symptom: Table cell edge strokes cannot be edited in the UI and lack gap colour and tint.
Text with CR or CRLF line endings becomes a single paragraph when inserted.
labels.root_cause: Text-creating commands kept carriage returns instead of turning them into paragraph separators.

labels.symptom: The app crashes at startup on some GPUs (e.g. Intel Macs with Device Lost) with no error logged.
labels.root_cause: Default wgpu adapter choice and indirect-call validation fail on some GPUs, and startup errors were not logged.

labels.symptom: Text runs over a placed image even though a text wrap is set on it.
labels.root_cause: The model had no wrap on graphics, IDML import read TextWrapPreference only from frames, and layout only checked top-level items.

labels.symptom: With right-to-left binding, pages show the opposite side's parent page items.
labels.root_cause: Parent page was chosen by list position instead of physical side.

labels.symptom: Kanji page numbering imported from IDML shows as Arabic numerals.
labels.root_cause: No kanji numbering style existed.

labels.symptom: Text wrap only uses the bounding box and Wrap To Both Sides sets text on one side.
labels.root_cause: Lines could hold only one segment and contours were treated as bounding boxes.

labels.symptom: The Pencil stroke only appears after the mouse button is released.
labels.root_cause: The canvas overlay painter skipped Overlay::Path.

labels.symptom: Automation commands given explicit object ids fail with 'nothing selected' when nothing is selected.
labels.root_cause: The command's enabled check looked only at the selection and ignored the ids param.
bug_markers: is not available right now: nothing selected

labels.symptom: The app crashes when a panel tries to draw an image taller than the GPU's texture limit.
labels.root_cause: UI textures larger than the 8192 px wgpu limit were uploaded as-is, which made wgpu panic.

labels.symptom: Japanese, Chinese and Korean menus and labels show as boxes, or sit above or below the Latin text next to them.
labels.root_cause: egui doesn't load system fonts, so there was no CJK fallback face, and fallback faces are centred in the line height instead of sharing the Latin baseline.

labels.symptom: The interface has no Traditional Chinese or Korean option, and tool names are always in English.
On the welcome screen, longer translated text runs underneath the Discord button.
labels.root_cause: The welcome card has a fixed width and its text does not wrap before the button's space.

labels.symptom: On macOS, after changing the interface language, the menu bar stays in the old language until the next launch.
labels.root_cause: The native menu bar was built once at launch and never rebuilt when the language changed.

labels.symptom: No Linux riscv64 release download is offered.
After undoing New Layer or deleting the active layer, new objects go onto an invisible phantom layer and are missing from exports.
labels.root_cause: The active layer is stored outside undo snapshots and was never re-validated when layers changed.

labels.symptom: PDF/X-4 export fails with a version mismatch error when a page holds a placed PDF 1.7 file.
labels.root_cause: krilla refuses to embed a PDF newer than the version it writes.

labels.symptom: On macOS, dragging files onto the app icon or opening them from Finder doesn't open them.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 doesn't expose the macOS open-documents event.

labels.symptom: A script placing several images at given positions keeps replacing the image in the selected frame.
labels.root_cause: file.place ignored an explicit position and filled the selected frame.

labels.symptom: Text commands accept a character fill that names no swatch in the document.
labels.root_cause: Fill names weren't checked against the document's swatches.

labels.symptom: SVG text whose font family name is spelled in a different case falls back to a serif font, with no warning.
labels.root_cause: fontdb's final query compares family names exactly, so a name in a different case is not found.

labels.symptom: Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
Print PDF exports write the paper colour as RGB white, which breaks PDF/X-4 compliance.
labels.root_cause: Paper was always written as DeviceRGB 1 1 1.

labels.symptom: Some actions leave an extra undo step that does nothing.
labels.root_cause: A command that runs another command recorded undo steps for both.

labels.symptom: Simplified Chinese fonts are listed under Japanese in the font menus.
labels.root_cause: For a pan-CJK font that lists several CJK code pages, the first group in menu order won and the region tag in the family name was ignored.

labels.symptom: A placed image can't be moved inside its frame.
Swatches, colour groups and layers can't be renamed from the UI.
Saved documents get no file extension, and the OS can't open documents from Finder or the file manager.
labels.root_cause: Save didn't add the extension, and the packaging declared no document types (the macOS plist still declared another app's).

labels.symptom: Frames imported from IDML lose the rounded corners, shadows and text wrap set by their object style.
labels.root_cause: The importer read these values from the page item alone and didn't inherit them from its object style.

labels.symptom: Gradient and directional feathers are lost when importing or exporting IDML.
labels.root_cause: The IDML importer and exporter ignored GradientFeatherSetting and DirectionalFeatherSetting.

labels.symptom: Print PDF exports blend transparency in RGB, which shifts CMYK colours and breaks PDF/X-4.
labels.root_cause: krilla writes every transparency group with a DeviceRGB blending space.

labels.symptom: Placing the same image several times embeds it once per placement, so saved files become huge.
labels.root_cause: Each placement created its own asset, and unused assets were never dropped on save.

labels.symptom: Hebrew and Arabic text in exported PDFs copies and searches reversed or with doubled letters.
labels.root_cause: Right-to-left glyphs were written in visual order, and vertical mark offsets split runs so letters were mapped twice.

labels.symptom: In exported PDFs, page numbers and list labels set in small caps extract as replacement characters.
labels.root_cause: Generated glyphs fell back to the font's reverse cmap, which has no entry for substituted glyphs.

labels.symptom: A smaller CJK run in a line of Latin text sits too low when aligned to the em box centre.
labels.root_cause: The em box was taken from the hhea ascender and descender instead of the BASE ideographic em box.

labels.symptom: Custom mojikumi tables imported without a base set are not applied.
labels.root_cause: Rules::resolve looked up the table's own name as a base preset and failed.

labels.symptom: Text set with optical kerning comes out wider and rewraps, because it is spaced as metrics kerning.
labels.root_cause: Shaping treated Optical kerning exactly like Metrics.

labels.symptom: CJK text cannot be set in frame grids of character cells.
Piping the command-line tool into a program that closes early, like head, makes it panic with a broken pipe error.
labels.root_cause: println! panics when stdout is closed.
bug_markers: failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe

labels.symptom: In PDF export, text runs through objects with soft effects instead of wrapping around them.
labels.root_cause: Rasterizing soft-effect objects replaced them with images that had no text wrap.

labels.symptom: Grouping objects that are already inside a group crashes, and mixed selections are partly grouped.
labels.root_cause: object.group indexed only the top-level items of the first object's spread.

labels.symptom: Preflight warns that placed vector PDF or SVG graphics have low resolution.
labels.root_cause: Effective resolution was computed from the screen preview pixels even for vector graphics.

labels.symptom: Clicking the live-corner widget on a rectangle does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The widget was drawn but had no click handling.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Preferences is under the Edit menu instead of Settings… in the application menu.
labels.root_cause: The native macOS app menu did not include the Settings item.

labels.symptom: Document views have no scrollbars, and you cannot pan temporarily while editing text.
Pressing Return or Escape in a dropdown inside a dialog also confirms or cancels the dialog.
labels.root_cause: The popup menu did not consume the key events it handled, so the dialog underneath also received them.

labels.symptom: There is no System theme option that follows the OS light/dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: The interface only offered fixed manual palettes.

labels.symptom: Printing doesn't reach a printer on Windows.
labels.root_cause: Printing used only CUPS lp, which doesn't exist on Windows.

labels.symptom: In Japanese mode some dialogs and panel controls still show English labels.
labels.root_cause: Some controls were not routed through the translation helpers.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: A document whose story revision counter is at its maximum value can no longer be edited.
labels.root_cause: Revision counters used checked increments that overflow at u64::MAX.

labels.symptom: Table dash patterns are lost on IDML round trips, and dotted borders render wrongly.
Copy and paste drops notes, and menu Paste in the browser does not get the system clipboard text.
labels.root_cause: Browser menu Paste did not read the system clipboard asynchronously.

labels.symptom: Smart text reflow recreates frames or pages the user deliberately deleted after unrelated edits.
labels.root_cause: Reflow did not respect explicit removals of primary frames/pages or track which inputs it consumed.

labels.symptom: The Windows Start Menu shortcut and Add/Remove Programs icon are blank, and a console window opens behind the app.
labels.root_cause: The MSI Icon Id lacked an .ico/.exe extension, and release builds used the console subsystem.

labels.symptom: Resizing with Alt or Shift moves the anchor, and the dimension readout shows matches the shape cannot actually reach.
Markdown files cannot be placed with their headings and emphasis mapped to styles.
Automation command descriptions don't explain the hyphenation default or the image fitting modes.
On Linux, fonts installed in a custom XDG_DATA_HOME font folder are not found.
labels.root_cause: Font discovery always uses the hardcoded path ~/.local/share/fonts and ignores XDG_DATA_HOME.

labels.symptom: Russian text is not hyphenated.
The font menu lacks class filters, style lists and sample options.
Text frame options and table controls do not open with the current values and can overwrite mixed selections.
Changing margins while editing a parent page changes the document pages instead, and Create Guides ignores the current page and ruler units.
labels.root_cause: The margins command only walked document spreads, never parent pages, and the current page resolved to page 0 while parents were being edited.

labels.symptom: The Document Setup dialog lacks margins and the expected layout.
The Windows Start Menu shortcut and Add/Remove Programs icon are blank, and a console window opens behind the app.
labels.root_cause: The MSI Icon Id lacked an .ico/.exe extension, and release builds used the console subsystem.

labels.symptom: In the browser, losing graphics context loses open work with no way to save a copy.
labels.root_cause: No recovery path kept document copies independent of the renderer after WebGL/WebGPU loss.

labels.symptom: Moving a sheared, rotated text frame leaves trails of old text on the canvas.
labels.root_cause: The damage region used the path bounds and left out the transformed text box.

labels.symptom: Imported IDML documents get extra gaps between consecutive same-style paragraphs.
labels.root_cause: IDML import ignored SameParaStyleSpacing.

labels.symptom: Single-sided pages show the second page of a two-page parent spread instead of the first.
labels.root_cause: parent_page_for picked the parent's last page for every side except Left, including Single.

labels.symptom: The command-line export writes a PNG for any file extension it doesn't recognise and still exits successfully.
labels.root_cause: The CLI export used a catch-all that rendered PNG for unknown extensions and matched extensions case-sensitively.

labels.symptom: Themes can't be starred as favorites, and there's no quick way to switch between them.
Fast clicks and typing on the canvas get misclassified as double-clicks or handled out of order.
labels.root_cause: Double-click classification and input ordering were not done per release within an input batch.

labels.symptom: The macOS app inside the DMG fails strict code-signature validation.
labels.root_cause: Build-time extended attributes and DMG packaging broke the signature.

labels.symptom: A crash, full disk or dropped network volume during save can destroy the existing document.
labels.root_cause: Saves and exports wrote over the target in place with std::fs::write instead of a temporary file and rename.

labels.symptom: The Selection and Direct Selection tool icons are swapped.
labels.root_cause: The hollow and filled arrow flags were swapped in the icon definitions.

labels.symptom: Canvas tools show generic system cursors, so the cursor doesn't say what a click will do.
labels.root_cause: Tool cursors were mapped to standard system cursors.

labels.symptom: At 115% interface scale an unneeded horizontal scrollbar appears in the header bar.
labels.root_cause: Fractional-scale rounding made the full-width tools slot slightly wider than its scroll area.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
No native Windows ARM64 installer is offered.
labels.root_cause: The release pipeline built only x64 Windows binaries.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be shown in Czech.
Alt + mouse wheel scrolls the canvas instead of zooming at the pointer.
Many interface strings stay in English when Brazilian Portuguese is selected.
labels.root_cause: The pt-BR catalog is missing strings that other languages translate.

labels.symptom: Resizing with Alt or Shift held cannot shrink frames and does not stay centred.
labels.root_cause: Modifiers were applied in the wrong order and anchored to the wrong points.

labels.symptom: Copied text loses its endnotes and notes, and damaged files can crash on paste.
labels.root_cause: Story::extract skipped endnotes and editorial notes and indexed payload lists without bounds checks.

labels.symptom: The search field in the top bar takes no clicks or typing.
labels.root_cause: The search field was only painted and was never a working text input.

labels.symptom: In exported EPUBs, styles with non-ASCII or near-duplicate names lose their formatting and take on another style's look.
labels.root_cause: Style names were slugged to CSS classes keeping only ASCII alphanumerics, so different styles collided on one class.

labels.symptom: Imported IDML text wraps around the frame instead of its custom wrap boundary.
labels.root_cause: The importer ignored the PathGeometry in TextWrapPreference.

labels.symptom: Margins and guides changed on a parent page do not carry over to the pages based on it.
labels.root_cause: Margins were stored only on each page, with no inheritance from the parent page.

labels.symptom: The interface language can only be set from a menu, not from Preferences.
Escape does not leave the full-screen presentation mode, leaving users stuck without menus.
labels.root_cause: Presentation mode had no Escape handler.

labels.symptom: Tamil, Devanagari, Thai and other scripts show as boxes in interface text.
labels.root_cause: The UI font fallback list had no fonts covering these scripts.

labels.symptom: Imported ICC profiles lose their original data, so you can't choose a press profile as the PDF output intent.
labels.root_cause: The color crate discarded the raw ICC bytes and gave profiles no stable ids.

labels.symptom: With two copies of the app running, crash recovery overwrites or deletes the other copy's unsaved documents.
labels.root_cause: All processes shared one recovery folder, with file names from a per-process counter that starts at 1.

labels.symptom: The interface isn't available in Russian.
There is no way to turn on optical margin alignment, so punctuation never hangs outside the margin.
labels.root_cause: The paragraph panel had no control for the optical margin setting the backend already supported.

labels.symptom: The repo ships a large bundled Japanese font instead of taking Japanese fonts from the shared font set.
labels.root_cause: Japanese fonts were committed into the repo instead of being an optional craft-fonts build input.

labels.symptom: CMYK colour components of 1% or less are read as fractions, which gives the wrong colours.
labels.root_cause: The parser picks a percent or fraction scale for each component separately instead of once per colour.

labels.symptom: Placed PDF pages and SVGs are drawn slightly stretched because their size is rounded to whole points, leaving gaps between pieces laid edge to edge.
labels.root_cause: The natural size of a placed page came from a pixel image size rounded to whole points instead of the exact crop box or SVG size.

labels.symptom: Portuguese text is not hyphenated.
labels.root_cause: The hypher portuguese feature is not enabled.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V do nothing on Linux even though Edit menu copy/paste works.
labels.root_cause: egui-winit turns Ctrl+C/X/V into Copy/Cut/Paste events, but the shortcut handler only looks at key events.

labels.symptom: When an automation request loses its reply, the edit gets applied twice.
labels.root_cause: The MCP remote backend reconnects and resends a request that failed mid-flight, even though the app may already have applied it.

labels.symptom: Thai, Lao, Khmer and Myanmar text breaks lines mid-word, and justification pulls marks off their letters.
labels.root_cause: The line breaker has no dictionary word segmentation for scripts written without spaces, and it letter-spaces between combining marks.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Simplified Chinese or Arabic, and right-to-left text is not supported.
Dragging with the middle mouse button does not pan the canvas.
Placed CMYK TIFF images are exported to PDF as RGB and lose their ink values.
labels.root_cause: TIFFs were decoded through image's decode_rgba, which converts CMYK to RGB.

labels.symptom: Guides on locked layers can still be moved or deleted through commands.
labels.root_cause: The guide move and delete commands did not check layer protection.

labels.symptom: PDF/X-4 export gives no warning when RGB images or colours are placed under a CMYK output intent.
labels.root_cause: The PDF/X-4 check never looked at colour spaces.

labels.symptom: License files and brand terms don't follow the shared licensing standard.
The README has no star history chart.
While automation control is on, a web page can send a cross-origin POST to the local port and have it run as a command.
labels.root_cause: The control server replied with an error to non-JSON lines but kept the connection open and kept reading.

labels.symptom: CI fails because of new Rust 1.99 clippy lints.
labels.root_cause: Rust 1.99's clippy flags chunks_exact with a constant size and other patterns.

labels.symptom: Chinese and Arabic typesetting settings are lost on import or not applied when text is laid out.
labels.root_cause: Import, the document model and composition did not carry CJK and Arabic typography rules.

labels.symptom: There is no data merge from CSV or Excel sources.
Some interface labels are untranslated in Arabic, and drawing RTL labels repeats layout work.
labels.root_cause: The Arabic table was missing entries, and RTL label layouts weren't cached.

labels.symptom: The Rotate and Shear menu items do nothing and open no dialog.
labels.root_cause: The command form parser dropped parameters written as 'key (description)', so those commands had no required fields and opened no dialog.

labels.symptom: Contributors have no enforced rule against panicking code, so crashes can slip into the app.
labels.root_cause: The workspace had no never-crash guidance, no clippy.toml test allowances, and only denied unsafe code instead of forbidding it.

labels.symptom: When a file can't be opened, nothing seems to happen because the error appears only in the status bar.
labels.root_cause: Open failures were reported only in the status line, with no alert dialog.

labels.symptom: Changing the colour of one letter breaks kerning, ligatures or Arabic joining with its neighbours.
labels.root_cause: Each formatting run was shaped separately, splitting paint-only style changes.

labels.symptom: Placed PSD files show the wrong colours, disappear, or crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The psd crate maps channels by count rather than colour mode and panics on damaged or 16-bit files.

labels.symptom: Text layout puts first baselines in the wrong place, Jump Object wraps behave wrongly, and imported drop caps do not appear.
labels.root_cause: Font metrics were taken from the wrong values and drop cap attributes were never laid out.

labels.symptom: Text frame editing lacks double-click edit, word selection, bold/italic toggles and system clipboard support.
CJK and other non-English text gets the wrong localized glyph forms, and Latin text in vertical frames shows up upside down and mirrored.
labels.root_cause: Language names were passed to the shaper without being mapped to OpenType language tags, and vert/vrt2 features were applied to every run.

labels.symptom: After clicking or drawing on the canvas, tool keyboard shortcuts do nothing until Esc is pressed.
labels.root_cause: The shortcut handler used egui_wants_keyboard_input(), which is true when any widget has focus, instead of checking only for a focused text field.

labels.symptom: Sibling-app references still use the old name PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
Empty paragraphs are too tall and push the following text into overset.
labels.root_cause: An empty line took its metrics from the paragraph style instead of from the character format of its paragraph mark.

labels.symptom: On a Mac, Calibri and other Microsoft Office fonts fall back to a default font even when Office is installed.
labels.root_cause: The system font scan skipped the fonts Office bundles inside its app bundles (Contents/Resources/DFonts).

labels.symptom: Adds clean-room import of native InDesign (.indd) documents.
